# 2 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> Situated in a quiet residential road to the east of Chichester city centre, this well-presented two-bedroom home offers a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors, within easy walking distance of local amenities.The property provides well-balanced accommodation, with a spacious sitting room leading through to a fitted kitchen/breakfast room overlooking the rear garden.
